user.title: Contextual Controls
user.description: Choose a name and mode. Local ranking always works; AI is configured later and can only reorder candidates.

data_description.included_entities: Combined with automatic domains. Explicit exclusions always win, including over pins.
data_description.included_domains: Clear this list to monitor only explicitly selected and pinned entities. Locks require explicit entity selection.

data_description.refresh_minutes: Relevant events always refresh with debounce. 15 minutes also guarantees a periodic evaluation; events-only does not update merely because the clock changed.
data_description.mode: Statistical uses only local ranking. Hybrid blends AI ordering when available. AI assisted gives it more weight without bypassing local filters.

data_description.included_entities: Combined with automatic domains. Explicit exclusions always win, including over pins.
data_description.included_domains: Clear this list to monitor only explicitly selected and pinned entities. Locks require explicit entity selection.
data_description.all_areas: When disabled, only entities in selected areas are eligible. Entity area takes precedence over device area.

data_description.learning_period_days: Collects from installation onward; does not import Recorder history. Up to 90 days are retained locally.
data_description.time_window_minutes: Symmetric around the current local time, including midnight. ±90 at 22:30 covers 21:00–00:00.
data_description.recency_weight: 0: no decay. 100: faster decay. Recent command attempts contribute more.
data_description.learn_sources: Direct authenticated commands are manual. Assist, automation and script ancestry is used only when Home Assistant Context events identify it; uncertain calls remain unknown.
data_description.user_id: Leave empty for all users. Otherwise enter the ID from Settings → People → Users. Unattributed commands are excluded for specific profiles.
data_description.ignored_entities: Stops new learning and hides existing statistical evidence without deleting history. Pins remain visible.
data_description.consider_weekday: When enabled, matching weekdays or workday/weekend groups receive more weight.
data_description.weekday_mode: Exact compares Monday with Monday. Workday/weekend groups Monday–Friday and Saturday–Sunday.

data_description.presence_entities: Choose person, device_tracker or binary_sensor entities. Binary sensors are home while on.
data_description.presence_mode: Signal adjusts ranking. Require home hides every suggestion, including pins, unless at least one configured entity is home.
data_description.context_entities: Used only as local scoring signals and never shown as controls. Unknown and unavailable states are ignored.

data_description.pinned_entities: Order can be rearranged. Excluded or unavailable entities remain hidden.
data_description.pinned_use_slots: Enabled: 2 pins + 4 dynamic controls for a limit of 6. Disabled: 2 pins + 6 dynamic controls.

data_description.minimum_confidence: Candidates below this statistical threshold are omitted. Pins bypass it. Fewer controls are normal during learning.
data_description.cold_start: Used until an entity has three matching records. Recent controls plus pins is the default. Domain defaults is an explicit opt-in.
data_description.debug: Adds score details for up to 30 ranked candidates. May contain entity IDs; disable before sharing screenshots.

data_description.entity_id: If set, reset only this entity. Combined with a user filter, resets their intersection.
data_description.user_id: Leave empty for all users. Otherwise enter the ID from Settings → People → Users. Unattributed commands are excluded for specific profiles.
data_description.confirm: Required. With no filters, deletes all learning for this instance. Cannot be undone without a backup.

ai.title: Optional AI
ai.description: AI can only reorder candidates already allowed locally. Statistical ranking is used on every failure.

data_description.ai_provider: Disabled keeps everything local. Ollama and OpenAI-compatible receive only the authorized shortlist.
data_description.candidate_pool_size: Maximum statistical candidates sent to the provider, from 6 to 30.
data_description.ai_min_refresh_minutes: Calls for changed context are rate-limited; identical context uses the cache.
data_description.ai_share_entity_id: When disabled, anonymous tokens such as candidate_1 are used.
data_description.ai_share_exact_timestamps: When disabled, only the current hour is sent without minutes.
data_description.ai_share_context_entities: Shares only selected context entities, never the complete state registry.

data_description.ollama_url: Local endpoint, for example http://localhost:11434. No API key is used.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the existing key. It is stored in ConfigEntry data.

quick_access.title: Quick Access / Apple
quick_access.description: Expose stable slots to Shortcuts, Apple Watch and the Lock Screen without recalculating ranking.

data_description.quick_access_slots: Creates 1–10 slot sensors with stable entity IDs.
data_description.quick_access_safety_mode: Safe blocks sensitive entities; Balanced allows common controls; Direct still requires confirmation for sensitive entities.
data_description.quick_access_stability: Temporarily keeps the published target to prevent changes between display and tap.
data_description.quick_access_sensitive_entities: These entities always follow sensitive policy, regardless of domain.
data_description.quick_access_response: Allows Shortcuts to receive the execute_slot JSON result.
data_description.quick_access_track_usage: Successful executions feed the same ranking history.
data_description.quick_access_usage_weight: Sets Quick Access usage confidence from 0 to 100.

error.entry_not_loaded: This integration instance must be loaded.
error.presence_required: Choose at least one presence entity for require-home mode.
error.entry_required: Choose an integration instance when more than one is configured.

state.domain_default: Selected by the configured domain defaults
state.presence_habit: Frequently used with the current presence
state.context_habit: Frequently used in the current home context
state.area_habit: Relevant to the currently occupied area

entry_not_loaded.message: This integration instance must be loaded.

storage_unavailable.message: Learning storage could not be loaded. Restore a backup or check the logs.

entry_required.message: Choose an integration instance when more than one is configured.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Required. With no filters, deletes all learning for this instance. Cannot be undone without a backup.

entity_id.name: Entity (optional)
entity_id.description: If set, reset only this entity. Combined with a user filter, resets their intersection.

user_id.name: Specific user ID (optional)
user_id.description: Leave empty for all users. Otherwise enter the ID from Settings → People → Users. Unattributed commands are excluded for specific profiles.

confirm.name: Confirm learning reset
confirm.description: Required. With no filters, deletes all learning for this instance. Cannot be undone without a backup.

get_slot.name: Get slot
get_slot.description: Returns the current target without executing an action.

execute_slot.name: Execute slot
execute_slot.description: Safely executes the target already published in the slot.

expected_entity_id.name: Expected entity
expected_entity_id.description: Rejects execution if the slot target has changed.

confirmed.name: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Use only after explicit user confirmation.

source.name: Source
source.description: Used only for learning and diagnostics.
